int_name: N FRONT ST & W GIRARD AVE

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is located beneath an elevated transit structure, which creates a dark, shadowed space with significant visual obstructions from large support pillars. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and traffic signals are present, the crosswalk markings are faded and the overall environment is dominated by heavy infrastructure that prioritizes vehicle flow.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Pillars
hazards.description: Large structural pillars for the elevated tracks block sight lines between drivers and pedestrians at the intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and sides of the roadway where pillars meet the ground

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk markings are heavily worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground crossing the main roadway

hazards.name: Poor Lighting and Shadows
hazards.description: The overhead structure creates deep shadows that can obscure pedestrians from drivers, even during daylight hours.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire roadway area underneath the elevated structure

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk with high-visibility 'continental' markings to improve driver awareness and pedestrian safety.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and move pedestrians into the driver's line of sight beyond the structural pillars.

interventions.title: Enhanced Under-Structure Lighting
interventions.description: Install brighter, pedestrian-scale LED lighting under the elevated structure to eliminate dark spots and improve visibility.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is situated under an elevated transit structure, creating a complex multi-modal space. While sidewalks and marked crosswalks are present, the large support pillars significantly obstruct sightlines, and the wide roadway increases pedestrian exposure to traffic.

hazards.name: Structural Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Large steel pillars supporting the elevated structure block sightlines between pedestrians waiting to cross and approaching vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground and background along the roadway.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway with multiple travel lanes and transit tracks increases the time pedestrians are exposed to traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the entire width of the street.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Islands
interventions.description: Install raised refuge islands between the transit tracks and travel lanes to provide a safe waiting area and reduce crossing distance.

interventions.title: Daylighting and Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend curbs at the intersection to improve visibility around the pillars and shorten the crossing distance.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Upgrade existing transverse markings to high-visibility continental markings to increase driver awareness.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is dominated by an elevated rail structure that creates significant visual clutter and deep shadows. While sidewalks and marked zebra crosswalks are present, the large support pillars and parked vehicles create substantial sightline obstructions at the intersection.

hazards.name: Structural Pillars
hazards.description: Large steel support pillars for the elevated rail are positioned near the curb, creating significant blind spots for both drivers and pedestrians at the crossing.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb line on both sides of the street

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parking
hazards.description: Vehicles parked right up to the crosswalk edge further restrict sightlines between turning motorists and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway approaching the crosswalk

hazards.name: Low Ambient Light
hazards.description: The overhead structure creates a dark environment with heavy shadows, making pedestrians less visible to drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire roadway area under the elevated tracks

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and place pedestrians in a more visible position beyond the pillars.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install additional lighting underneath the elevated structure specifically aimed at the crosswalk and sidewalk areas.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is significantly impacted by an elevated rail structure and street-level trolley tracks, which create visual obstructions and tripping hazards. While sidewalks are present, the lack of marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals at the intersection increases exposure to vehicular traffic.

hazards.name: Elevated Rail Pillars
hazards.description: Large steel support pillars for the elevated rail line obstruct sightlines between pedestrians and motorists at the intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the roadway edge and center

hazards.name: Streetcar Tracks
hazards.description: Embedded tracks in the roadway create tripping hazards for pedestrians and can catch bicycle tires.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The intersection lacks painted crosswalks, providing no designated or protected space for pedestrians to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground intersection area

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install zebra-striped crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way and improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct sidewalk extensions at the corners to shorten crossing distances and move pedestrians into the driver's line of sight past the pillars.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Heads
interventions.description: Add dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to the existing traffic light infrastructure.
